## Page or command

Link the affected page, or provide the documented command path.

## What is wrong or unclear?

Describe the inaccurate, missing, outdated, or confusing information.

## What does the bot currently show?

Paste the relevant sanitized output from:

```text
-help <command>
-help <command> <subcommand>
```

Do not include tokens, private server details, Discord IDs, private-channel content, or personal data.

## Expected documentation

Explain what the page should say or how it should be organized.

## Who is affected?

- [ ] Member
- [ ] Moderator or delegated manager
- [ ] Administrator
- [ ] Discord server owner
- [ ] SickGamingBot maintainer

## Additional context

Include the loaded cog name or relevant Sick-Cogs issue when known.
